user.title: Connect to a Jackery power station
user.description: Select a Jackery unit Home Assistant has already seen over Bluetooth, or enter its MAC address manually.

confirm.title: Add Jackery unit
confirm.description: Add the Jackery power station "{name}" discovered over Bluetooth?

abort.already_configured: This Jackery unit is already configured
abort.not_jackery_device: The discovered Bluetooth device does not look like a Jackery unit

data.github_reporting_enabled: Automatically file GitHub issues for unexpected errors
data.github_token: GitHub personal access token (Issues: write only)

error.token_required: A token is required to enable GitHub issue reporting

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Immediately poll a Jackery unit over BLE.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Jackery device to refresh. Optional if only one is configured.

send_raw_command.name: Send raw command
send_raw_command.description: Send an arbitrary JSON command directly to the device over BLE and return its response. Useful for testing or correcting the reverse-engineered protocol.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Jackery device to send the command to. Optional if only one is configured.

command.name: Command
command.description: A JSON object to send, e.g. {"cmd": "data_get", "type": "full"}.

scan_bluetooth_devices.name: Scan Bluetooth devices
scan_bluetooth_devices.description: List every Bluetooth device Home Assistant currently sees nearby, not just ones already recognized as Jackery, with name, address, signal strength, and advertised service UUIDs. Useful for finding a unit that isn't showing up in Add Integration, or for troubleshooting discovery in general.
